description: This PHP source file defines the 'iCal' class, which extends 'vCal', and provides functionality to generate iCalendar (iCal) data for user calendar events, reminders, and tasks within the SuiteCRM system. It handles timezone conversions, DST calculations, and constructs calendar entries for meetings, calls, tasks, and project tasks for a specified user.

classes.name: iCal
classes.description: Class for constructing iCalendar responses, extending vCal, providing methods for generating calendar data including events, reminders, and tasks for a specific user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the iCal object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: getUtcDateTime
methods.description: Returns a UTC formatted string from the provided SugarDateTime object.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a UTC formatted date-time string, considering user timezone adjustments.

methods.name: convertMinsToHoursAndMins
methods.description: Converts minutes into a string representing hours and minutes in ±HHMM format.

methods.name: createSugarIcalTodo
methods.description: Creates a VTODO entry for a given Task or ProjectTask with appropriate details.

methods.name: createSugarIcal
methods.description: Generates calendar entries for user activities, including meetings, calls, tasks, and project tasks between start and end times.

methods.name: getUserTimezone
methods.description: Retrieves the user's timezone as a DateTimeZone object.

methods.name: getDSTRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end of daylight savings time for the user for a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneString
methods.description: Generates the timezone component of the iCal with daylight savings information.

methods.name: getVcalIcal
methods.description: Produces the complete iCalendar string for the user, covering a range of months around the current date, including events, reminders, and tasks.
